title.en: Establishing the Lungsod Silangan Mental Health Center and Providing for the 5-Year Decentralization Program of the National Mental Hospital and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Creation. There is hereby established a health center to be known as the Lungsod Silangan
Mental Health Center under the supervision of the Department of Health.

Organization. The Center shall be headed by a chief of Hospital assisted by one or more assistant
chiefs and such staffs and operating units as may be organized pursuant to law.

Creation of Regional Mental Health Centers.
(1) There shall be created regional mental health centers in the twelve (12) health regions of the country
within a period of five years.
(2) The present National Mental Health Hospital shall be retained for purposes of training and research in
Mental Health.

A mental hospital for the Criminal Insane is hereby created under the supervision of the
Secretary of Health.

Funds and Resources. (1) The initial outlay for the establishment of the Lungsod Silangan
Mental Health Center shall come for the Metro-Manila Commission Funds, Calamity fund of the Office of the
President, a loan for the GSIS and the allocation in the annual General Appropriations Act for the Center.
(2) The infrastructure program for the Regional Mental Hospitals and the Mental Health hospital for criminal
insane shall be included in the annual appropriations of the Bureau of Public Works and their operation and

maintenance shall be under their respective regional health offices.

Project Implementation. The Project Management Staff of the Department of Health created
under Presidential Decree No. 568 is hereby authorized to undertake and supervise the implementation of the
projects in coordination with the National Mental Health Hospital authorities.

The Secretary of Health is hereby authorized to call upon any department, bureau, agency or
instrumentality of the Government of such assistance as may be necessary to effectively implement this

All laws or parts of laws inconsistent with the provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed,
modified or amended accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
